caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF JOSEPH MICHAEL OWENS
text: Joseph Michael Owens, of Baltimore, Maryland, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of November 10, 2025; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Joseph Michael Owens is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
